$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for editor validation.

id.description: Declared contribution id. Effective id is authorId.packId.type.id at scan time.

name.description: Human-readable display label. May be empty on workshop drafts.

author.description: Freeform credit for the contribution's creator. Independent of pack.json authorId (pack maintainer/distributor).

description.description: Short summary for lists/cards; keep longer notes in the pack README.

tokens.description: CSS custom property tokens. Required keys are enforced before apply; workshop drafts may omit keys while saving.
